definitions.full: H4860. mashshaon מַשָּׁאוֺן noun [masculine] guile, dissimulation ( > according to Lag BN 196 derived from מַשָּׁא , lending on usury ); בְּמַשָּׁאוֺן שִׂנְאָה תִּכַּסֶּה Prov 26:26 hatred may hide itself with dissimulation .
